voucher_rent_ceiling.what_this_is: the range a PHA's voucher payment standard can be set to (90-110% of the metro/county FMR). It is a ceiling on gross rent (rent + tenant-paid utilities), not a promised rent: the PHA also caps rent at local comparable unassisted rents (rent reasonableness) and subtracts tenant-paid utilities.
